cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make your coffee. You gave this button a firm press; I'll start there too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. I was cleaning it. The coffee button's behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, clean first. Now the flap. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dial to one. I always adjust it for the guest.

reason: Remove the detachable sugar question after the completed dial adjustment; preserve every other line.
